app_intro: A first step towards checking your references.
input_hint: Paste one reference. You can also put each reference on its own line.
input_example: Darwin, C. (1859). On the Origin of Species. John Murray.
skeleton_notice: Development preview with uncalibrated comparison rules. Article searches may use OpenAlex and Crossref when enabled. Some source types cannot yet be fully checked. No public service is available.
problem_invalid_request: Review your input and try again. The request could not be understood.
problem_check_not_found: Start a new check with your references. This check is no longer available.
problem_forbidden: Check that you are signed in to the right account. You do not have permission for this action.
problem_internal: Try again. A technical error occurred on our side. A technical status uses no quota; completed verdicts remain debited.
problem_connection: Check your connection and the progress of your check. A lost connection does not mean the check stopped. Already debited reference slots are not debited again.
structuring_summary: {count} references recognized. Structuring consumes no quota.
structuring_no_references: No references recognized. Paste a bibliography with an author, title and year, or an identifier such as a DOI. Put each reference on a new line.
structuring_exact_notice: Fields are shown exactly as written. Uncertain fields stay empty. Sources have not been verified.
structuring_truncated: The author list is explicitly truncated in the original text.
problem_reference_limit: Split your bibliography into smaller lists. At most {limit} references can be processed at once.
citation_style_reset: Your saved citation style is no longer available. APA is selected; you can choose another style.
doi_uncalibrated: Development preview: uncalibrated rules. Not qualified for decisions or release.
reason_outside_coverage: This source type is outside coverage; no DOI verification is required.
reason_doi_nonexistent: The neutral doi.org Handle resolver confirms that the supplied DOI does not exist.
reason_foreign_doi: The DOI points to a different source. Independent title and author evidence identifies the intended source.
reason_resolution_incomplete: Mandatory neutral DOI resolution is incomplete or unavailable. Crossref alone cannot establish DOI nonexistence.
reason_metadata_unavailable: No usable metadata was obtained from Crossref. A missing Crossref record does not mean that the DOI does not exist.
reason_identity_unresolved: Source identity remains unresolved. A high score alone is not identity evidence.
reason_route_incomplete: This source route has incomplete evidence and cannot yet be fully checked.
reason_identified: The evidence establishes this source unambiguously. All compared fields agree. Missing fields are listed below.
reason_fields_differ: The source is unambiguously identified, but the marked fields differ. Both original values are shown.
evidence_no_record: No record in this data source
best_match_label: Best match by score; identity is assessed separately.
field_not_determinable: Not determinable with the available evidence.
field_missing_reference: Missing from the reference; not scored.
field_missing_candidate: Missing from the candidate; not scored.
field_resource_limit: A comparison resource limit was reached; the field was not scored.
reason_url_incomplete: URL or archive evidence is incomplete. This does not prove that the source does not exist.
check_lease_expired: The connection was not renewed in time. Finished verdicts are kept; unfinished references were cancelled.
check_cleanup_pending: Cancellation could not be confirmed. This workspace has stopped renewing its connection. Another active workspace may keep the check running.
problem_authority_unavailable: Try again. Current authorization is unavailable; a new check starts only after confirmation.
problem_guest_identity_storage: Allow local browser storage and try again. It is required to keep your guest identity.
limitation_deadline: The time limit for this reference was reached before the data source could finish.
limitation_rate_budget: The data source is busy or its request limit was reached. Try this reference again later.
limitation_response_size: The data source response was too large to process safely.
limitation_request_unavailable: The data source could not be reached. Try this reference again later.
limitation_invalid_resolver_response: The DOI resolver did not return usable confirmation for this DOI.
limitation_not_in_crossref: Crossref has no metadata record for this DOI. This does not prove that the DOI does not exist.
limitation_invalid_metadata: The data source returned incomplete or invalid metadata.
limitation_identifier_mismatch: The returned metadata belongs to a different identifier.
limitation_probe_unavailable: The search for an independently matching source could not be completed.
limitation_unknown: The data source evidence is incomplete. Try this reference again later.
reason_mixed_components: Strong independent evidence links the title and authors to different sources, with contradictory opposing fields.
reason_search_completed: The completed search in the enabled data sources found no sufficiently matching source. This does not prove that the source does not exist.
reason_ambiguous_identity: The candidates do not establish one unambiguous source. Review the competing or missing identity evidence.
reason_insufficient_search: The search could not be completed or found too little evidence. This does not prove that the source does not exist.
limitation_identifier_capability: This identifier lookup is not currently supported. It was not sent and is not evidence that the source is absent.
limitation_missing_query_fields: The fields required for this search were not supplied.
retraction_reported: The best match is reported as retracted.
retraction_independent: The retraction report is independent of the citation verdict.
workspace_empty: References matching the selected filter will appear here. Choose “All references” to see the whole check.
workspace_select: Select a reference to see its detail.
workspace_no_best: No best match is available. Source identity has not been established.
workspace_human: A verdict is not proof of deception. A human makes the decision.
workspace_method: References are structured into fields, searched in enabled data sources and compared with candidates. The server supplies the verdict, its explanation and the best match. A score measures field agreement, not the probability that a source exists.
workspace_limits: Unknown or missing evidence is not agreement or a zero score. Incomplete verification is explained separately from a completed search with no match. Retraction reports concern the best match and are independent of the verdict.
reason_sources_unavailable: None of the responsible data sources could be searched. This does not prove that the source does not exist.
limitation_timeout: The data source did not respond in time.
limitation_after_source_failure: Not sent because this data source had already failed for this reference.
failure_rate_limit: request limit reached or waiting time too long
failure_deadline: time limit for this reference reached
failure_error: returned an error or could not be reached
journal_abbreviation_match: The journal abbreviation is attested for this candidate’s journal.
journal_abbreviation_different: The abbreviation is attested for another journal. The candidate’s journal has a different attested abbreviation.
journal_abbreviation_unknown: The journal abbreviation cannot be reliably assigned to this candidate’s journal. This field is unscored; the remaining weights are renormalized.
journal_nlm_snapshot: NLM snapshot: {date}. This pinned snapshot may not reflect the most current NLM data.
correction_export_hint: Export selections apply only to the formatted bibliography. Original input, fields and verdicts stay unchanged.
correction_copy_failed: Select and copy the text, or download the RTF file. Copying failed.
correction_unavailable: Try formatting again. It is currently unavailable.
correction_none_selected: No corrections selected. The export uses the current fields.
export_references_hint: Original references uses current saved fields, including your edits. Selected suggestions apply only to this download. Stored evidence stays unchanged.
export_preview: Format: {format} · Citation style: {style}. These data formats retain fields; the style formats the suggestion preview.
export_failed: Check your connection and access, refresh the check if needed, then try the download again. The download failed.
document_upload_hint: PDF or DOCX. The current upload limit is checked before sending. The extracted text appears below for review before you start a check.
problem_document_size_limit: Upload a PDF or DOCX of at most {limit} MB. The document is too large.
problem_document_unsupported: Upload a PDF or DOCX document.
problem_document_no_text: Paste the references as text if the PDF is scanned. This document contains no extractable text.
problem_document_encrypted: Upload an unencrypted copy. This document is encrypted.
problem_document_unreadable: Try a valid PDF or DOCX copy. This document could not be read.
problem_document_page_limit: Upload a shorter document. The PDF exceeds the page limit.
problem_document_expansion_limit: Upload a smaller document. The expanded DOCX exceeds the size limit.
problem_document_time_limit: Try a smaller document or paste its references. Reading the document took too long.
problem_document_resource_limit: Try a simpler document or paste its references. Reading the document exceeded a resource limit.
problem_document_aborted: Reading the document was stopped. You can try again.
problem_document_unavailable: Try again later or paste the references. Document reading is temporarily unavailable.
revision_free: Already debited reference slot: a re-check uses no additional quota.
revision_new_work: Previously unbilled reference slot: the first verdict uses one check of quota. Technical statuses use no quota.
revision_draft: Unsaved draft. The displayed result belongs to the earlier committed fields. Save once when ready.
revision_membership_note: List changes are available when no reference is running. Adding creates new work; correcting fields keeps the same slot.
revision_original: Original input for the new reference
revision_preview_counts: Add {added}, remove {removed}. Resulting references: {total}. Additional quota on first verdicts: {quota}.
revision_no_refund: Removal does not refund consumed quota. New references start after applying these changes.
problem_reference_conflict: Review the current fields and reopen the edit action before trying again. This reference changed or is running.
problem_check_expired: Start a new check with your references. This check expired.
reason_web_original_unavailable: The original URL is no longer available. An archived page establishes the original URL and matching title.
reason_url_unavailable: The DOI identifies the source, but the supplied URL is no longer available.
identity_web_url: The URL and title identify the source.
identity_web_archive: The original URL and title identify the archived source.
limitation_unsafe_url: This URL was refused for safety or could not be read as an HTTP/HTTPS destination. No evidence of non-existence follows.
limitation_web_inconclusive: The response does not establish a readable page with reliable title evidence.
limitation_redirect_limit: The URL could not be verified within the limit of five redirects.
limitation_archive_mismatch: The archive response does not establish a capture of the cited original URL.
evidence_redirect: Redirect; the target is checked separately
override_note: Manual judgment changes only this result’s effective verdict. Fields, scores, evidence and correction suggestions stay unchanged.
override_reset: The manual verdict was reset by the re-check. The previous judgment remains with its historical result.
auth_guest_notice: Guest checks and guest quota are not transferred when you register.
auth_code_sent: Check your email. The code expires after five minutes.
auth_invalid: Request a new code after the waiting period. The code is invalid, expired or already used.
auth_unavailable: Try again shortly. Sign-in is temporarily unavailable.
auth_limited: Wait before requesting another code. There were too many attempts.
auth_expired: Sign in again to continue. Your session has expired or was revoked.
library_import_hint: Choose a UTF-8 .bib or .ris file, up to 20 MB. Malformed records are listed separately. Importing consumes no quota.
library_unsupported: Unsupported fields (preserved in the original record)
problem_library_size: Split the file into smaller files. It exceeds 20 MB.
problem_library_format: Choose a BibTeX (.bib, .bibtex) or RIS (.ris) file.
problem_library_encoding: Export the file as UTF-8 from your reference manager. The file is not valid UTF-8.
library_no_references: Review the rejected records or export a UTF-8 BibTeX or RIS file from your reference manager. No references could be imported.
selection_none: No bibliography detected or selected. Mark a region by hand; no text will be checked until you select it.
selection_help: Only highlighted text is structured and checked. Move each region using its start and end, or select text in the original input and add it as a region. Positions count characters from 0; the end is excluded.
selection_add: Add marked text as a region
selection_invalid: Use non-overlapping regions inside the document, with start before end.
selection_limit: Reduce the selection. It exceeds {limit} references. Nothing was truncated or checked.
selection_original: Original document text — mark a region here
selection_versions: Bibliography detection: {version}. Parser rules remain available in every plan.
selection_empty: Copy and paste the text. No selection was taken over.
selection_intake_help: Copy and paste the text if the page uses its own menus or canvas editors, the field is a password field, or a private window lacks extension permission.
selection_shortened: Paste the text or upload a file for longer lists. The selection may have been shortened.
preferences_unavailable: Account preferences could not be synchronized. Retry to load the saved values.
preferences_sync_off: Your language and citation style are saved only in this browser. To sync them with your account, allow Source Taster to send this settings data to the service.
preferences_sync_declined: Preferences sync was not allowed. Your preferences stay in this browser.
preferences_sync_on: Preferences sync is on. You can turn it off in the Firefox add-on settings; your preferences then stay in this browser.
quota_unavailable: Try again. Quota is currently unavailable. A check starts only once your balance can be read.
quota_warning_eighty: You have used 80% of your quota. A larger plan or a check pack provides more quota.
quota_warning_exhausted: Choose another plan or a check pack to check more references. Your quota is used up.
quota_preview_fits: {required} references will use {required} of your {remaining} remaining checks. {after} will be left.
quota_choice_heading: Not enough quota for all references
quota_choice_body: You entered {required} references but have {available} checks left. Check only the first {available} in input order (the rest are not checked), or choose another plan or a check pack.
quota_choice_none: Choose another plan or a check pack to continue. You entered {required} references but have no checks left.
quota_started: Started {started} of {required} references; {skipped} were not checked.
problem_quota_insufficient: Choose fewer references, another plan or a check pack. There is not enough quota for this work.
problem_abuse_limit: Wait before trying again. There were too many requests.
problem_abuse_unavailable: Try again later. Request limits are temporarily unavailable.
sensitive_proof_intro: For your security, confirm that it is you. We send a six-digit code to {email}. The confirmation is valid for five minutes and for this one action only.
sensitive_proof_code_sent: We sent a code to your current address. It expires after five minutes.
sensitive_proof_expired: Confirm again to continue. The confirmation expired.
sensitive_proof_required: Confirm again to continue. A fresh confirmation is required. Nothing was changed.
sensitive_proof_invalid: Request a new code after the waiting period. The code is invalid, expired or already used.
sensitive_proof_exhausted: Request a new code after the waiting period. There were too many wrong codes.
sensitive_rate_limited: Wait before trying again. There were too many attempts.
sensitive_unavailable: This action is not available yet. Nothing was changed.
sensitive_temporarily_unavailable: Try again shortly. This action is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed.
sensitive_failed: The action failed. Nothing was changed.
sensitive_new_email_sent: If this address can be used, a code is on its way. It expires after five minutes.
sensitive_new_email_invalid: The code is invalid or expired, or the address cannot be used. Nothing was changed.
sensitive_email_changed: Your email address is now {email}. Your account stays the same.
sensitive_delete_notice_content: All your checks and their results are deleted and cannot be restored. You are signed out on every device.
sensitive_delete_notice_retention: Billing records that the law requires us to keep are blocked from any other use and kept for eight years. This deletion does not remove them.
sensitive_delete_notice_quota: Your remaining quota ({remaining} checks) is lost and not restored.
sensitive_delete_notice_quota_unknown: Your remaining quota is lost and not restored.
sensitive_delete_ack: I understand that billing records are kept for eight years and that this deletion cannot be undone.
sensitive_deleted: Your account was deleted. Nothing from it was carried over to guest use.
sensitive_deletion_in_progress: Your account deletion is in progress. Access stays blocked until it finishes.
sensitive_deletion_failed: The account was not deleted. You are still signed in and nothing was changed.
ai_uncertainty: AI results can be wrong. Check the extracted fields against your original text.
ai_excluded: Excluded from search and scoring until you explicitly adopt it as a correction.
ai_guest: AI extraction is unavailable to guests. The parser was used. Upgrade to a paid plan for AI extraction.
ai_feature_unavailable: Your current feature scope does not include AI extraction. The parser was used. Upgrade to a paid plan for AI extraction.
ai_configuration_unavailable: AI extraction is currently unavailable. The parser was used.
ai_fallback: AI extraction failed after one retry for this passage. The parser was used. You can structure the passage again.
history_policy: History is off until you opt in. Free keeps the last five checks for 30 days; paid plans keep checks for 90 days. Existing deletion dates never change.
history_empty: No earlier checks yet. Checks are kept when they end.
history_billable: This creates a new check of {count} references. Their first verdicts use quota again. The earlier check stays unchanged. Opening uses no quota. Within the same check, already debited reference slots use no additional quota on a re-check. Previously unbilled slots can use quota on their first verdict.
history_delete_warning: Delete this check and all its content permanently?
history_revoke_warning: Revoking history permanently deletes all stored checks, including locked entries. Future checks use the 24-hour deletion rule.
history_unavailable: Refresh history and try again. It could not be loaded or changed.
problem_history_locked: This entry is locked under the Free rules. A paid plan unlocks it until its original deletion date.
problem_feature_unavailable: Choose a plan that includes PDF reports to download one. Your current plan does not include them.
problem_report_not_found: Create a new report. This report is unavailable.
problem_report_not_ready: Wait until the report is finished before downloading it.
problem_report_busy: Wait until the current report finishes. A report for this check is already being created.
problem_report_expired: Create a new report. The report download expired.
report_ui_hint: A tagged PDF with this check's verdicts, explanations, correction suggestions and manual changes. It is a temporary file: it is available for 15 minutes at most, never longer than this check, and has no sharing link.
report_ui_unavailable: The accessible PDF report is not available for your account.
report_ui_intermediate: This check is still running. The report will show an intermediate snapshot; unfinished references keep their status.
report_ui_ready: The report is ready and available for download until {time}.
report_ui_failed_unsupported: Review the text for unsupported characters. The report could not be created because the embedded fonts cannot show those characters. Nothing was created.
report_ui_failed_limit: Export the references instead. The report exceeds the allowed limits and could not be created.
report_ui_failed_unavailable: Try again. The report could not be created.
report_ui_expired: Create a new report. The report is no longer available.
report_ui_error: Try again. The report request failed.
report_intermediate: Intermediate snapshot as of {date}. The check was still running; unfinished references keep their status.
report_final: Final snapshot as of {date}. The check had ended.
report_differences: Fields that differ from the best match
report_no_differences: No differing fields were recorded for the best match.
report_no_suggestion: No correction suggestion is available for this reference.
report_scoring_versions: Scoring rules versions in this report
report_not_verdict: No verdict is available for this reference.
report_retracted: Retraction reported for the best match; independent of the verdict.
commerce_open: Plans and check packs on the web
dpa_review: Review the complete versioned packet and your contracting party before concluding.
dpa_legal_review: Agreement content requires human legal review. This product flow makes no legal-sufficiency claim.
dpa_authority: I use the service for business and am authorized to conclude for this contracting party.
dpa_pending: A confirmation code was requested for this packet and party. It expires within five minutes.
dpa_not_offered: No agreement packet is currently offered.
dpa_failed: Check completion before retrying. The request failed.
dpa_conflict: Start a new review. The packet or contracting party changed; no different agreement was concluded.
dpa_proof_failed: Review again if needed. The code is invalid, expired or belongs to another session.
dpa_limited: Wait before requesting another code. There were too many requests or code attempts.
dpa_hold: New processing is held until the contractual prerequisites are reviewed and resolved.
dpa_sent: Notice email sent; contractual notification still requires review
dpa_recovery_pending: Check again or start a new review. This operation has no confirmed conclusion yet.
dpa_expired: Start a new review. The confirmation window expired.
dpa_party_change: Changing the current contracting party requires a reviewed support procedure.
invoices_unavailable: Try again. Invoices are currently unavailable.
maintenance_announcement: Planned maintenance: {start}–{end} ({zone}). The service may be unavailable during this time.
maintenance_withdrawn: The planned maintenance has been withdrawn.
shell_empty_input: Enter references or choose a file to start.
shell_busy: Wait for the current operation or stop the check.
shell_selection_blocked: Adjust the bibliography selection or reset to enter new references.
shell_drop: Drop PDF, DOCX, BibTeX or RIS files here.
